svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Door: cut 136 x 140 mm from 3 mm UV-stabilized clear polycarbonate (score and snap,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: or a fine saw); round the corners 5 mm; keep the film on to drill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 13 mm hole for the knob stem, 70 mm from the rear edge, 70 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.5 mm holes for the thumb screws: 12 from the rear edge 125 up,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 124 from the rear edge 15 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Knob: print a 28 mm head, 10 thick, on a 12 mm stem 10.5 long; press

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: an M6 x 25 screw through its centre as a stud (head moulded in).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the door covers the opening on the housing's door side with two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M4 thumb screws; the knob stem passes the door and screws into the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft end, clamping the plate against the shaft collar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Liners: two discs 122 mm across, 2 mm thick, with a 22 mm hole and a notch

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16 mm tall at the brush. Chain side: two 3 mm pegs 4 long, 48 mm each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of centre. Door side: two 5 mm pegs, 6 long, that rest on the door.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: For an 8 mm plate the chain-side liner is 1 mm; a 10 mm plate has none.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: door off and knob out in under a minute, no tools.
